teaser.en: A small ebony with wood so hard that botanists named it after iron.
teaser.sw: Mpingo mdogo wenye mbao ngumu kiasi kwamba wataalamu wa mimea waliupa jina la chuma.

summary.en: Mshipa is a small tree or shrub of the ebony family, Diospyros ferrea, found in coastal bush and forest. Pakia records only its name.
summary.sw: Mshipa ni mti mdogo au kichaka cha familia ya abunusi (ebony), Diospyros ferrea, kinachopatikana katika vichaka na misitu ya pwani. Pakia anarekodi jina lake tu.

about.en: Mshipa is a shrub or small tree with neat, leathery, glossy leaves arranged alternately along the twigs and dark bark. Like other ebonies it bears small, pale, bell-shaped flowers and small round fruits that ripen from orange to black. Its scientific name ferrea, 'of iron', refers to its very hard, heavy wood.
about.sw: Mshipa ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani nadhifu, magumu kama ngozi na yanayong'aa, yaliyopangwa kwa kupishana kwenye vitawi, na gome jeusi. Kama mipingo mingine, huzaa maua madogo, meupe hafifu, yenye umbo la kengele, na matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva kutoka rangi ya chungwa hadi meusi. Jina lake la kisayansi ferrea, 'wa chuma', linarejelea mbao zake ngumu na nzito sana.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and dry forest, including coral-rag country, along the East African coast and across the Indian Ocean region.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka, vichaka-mwitu vizito na misitu mikavu ya pwani, ikiwemo maeneo ya mawe ya matumbawe, kando ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki na katika eneo lote la Bahari ya Hindi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mshipa but gives no meaning or shared names. In Mgombato, mshipa is the ordinary word for a vein or tendon, and also for certain pains and illnesses, but no link to the tree is recorded. Its scientific name is Diospyros ferrea.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mshipa lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Katika Mgombato, mshipa ni neno la kawaida la mshipa wa damu au kano, na pia la maumivu na magonjwa fulani, lakini hakuna uhusiano na mti huu uliorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Diospyros ferrea.
